SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA --- 3,949,240
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId --- 3,949,240
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId --- 868,848
---LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.DepositAccountStatus BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')SELECT top 100 * FROM BUSC.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE WHERE SOL_ID = '6190'
SELECT top 100 * FROM BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE
SELECT top 100 * FROM BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE WHERE SET_ID LIKE 'AR%' OR SET_ID LIKE 'REG%' 

SELECT SET_DESC, * FROM BUSC.DEP_SOLIDSETTABLE A LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE B ON A.SET_ID = B.SET_ID
   WHERE (B.SET_ID LIKE 'AR%' OR B.SET_ID LIKE 'REG%') AND A.SOL_ID = '6190' AND B.BANK_ID = 'CBC02'

SELECT FROM BUSC.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE A LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_SETIDTABLE B ON A.SET_ID = B.SET_ID
   WHERE B.SET_ID LIKE 'AR%' OR B.SET_ID LIKE 'REG%' AND A.SOL_ID = '6190'
